newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal non-tradable goods inflation 4.2 pct Oct.
newsitem.headline: Portugal non-tradable goods inflation 4.2 pct Oct.

text.p: Prices of non-tradable goods rose 4.2 percent year-on-year in October, slower than September's 4.5 percent, a spokesman for the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.
Month-on-month, non-tradables rose 0.3 percent against 0.1 percent in September.
Tradable goods prices fell 0.4 percent month-on-month in October against a fall of 0.1 percent in September, while they rose 1.9 percent year-on-year, down from 2.5 percent in September.
Earlier, the INE announced that Portugal's consumer price index fell 0.1 percent month-on-month in October. Year-on-year, the index rose 3.0 percent.
